Overlapping repeated blocks remain separate observations; widths summed unique-coverage estimate. chr_fill ribbon_fill follow linear function’s coloring modes. gap = 1 separates chromosomes within species group_gap = 10 separates species (degrees). species_order selects orders genomes. Repeated chromosome labels different species kept separate.  default coverage ribbons join opposite interval boundaries clarity. blocks$orientation available, show_orientation = TRUE connects genomic start/end coordinates according plus minus. plus alignment, starts connect starts; minus alignment, starts connect ends. chromosomes may run clockwise around different portions circle, twist alone inversion indicator. Colouring ribbons rice source chromosome makes block structure pop — note rice 1 maps almost entirely sorghum 3, rice 11/12 sorghum 5/8:  blocks data frame keeps MCScanX’s alignment score gene count per block, can filter harder plotting:
